trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy on this list and the platinum unlocks automatically. It is the last trophy most players earn, after the 100% completion and collectible hunts.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing until its closing scene. It unlocks as part of the story, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops when the chapter's final cutscene ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2, including the chapter's closing job. Story only, so just keep playing the main missions.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops at the end of the chapter's last mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. The trophy unlocks when the credits roll after the last job.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. Follow the mission markers and finish the job to unlock it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission from start to finish. Stick with your crew through the escape and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. Finish its final objective and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. Finish the airport job and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. See the mission through to its ending.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: finish the story, all stranger strands, activities, collectibles and challenges the completion counter tracks. Check the in-game stats screen to see what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts: jumps, near misses and airtime all count. Chain them during free-roam driving rather than hunting them one by one.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade, bowling, hunting, challenges and meditation all count as a type. One attempt each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each range's target pattern first on a lower medal, then run it clean for gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own course, so win them one at a time.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida's race types. A race only counts the first time you win that particular event.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Use the best rod and bait you can afford and keep the line tension in the safe zone.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game from start to finish. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Work through Andy's mission strand until no more of his jobs remain.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Finish Kenton's strand to the end.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Finish Billy's strand to the end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as question marks on the map; finish all of a stranger's missions to complete one strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Finish Randy's strand to the end.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Finish Tyrone's strand to the end.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida, and do the Chapter 1 spot before Chapter 1 ends, because there is no mission replay. Visit each marked meditation spot and complete the session there.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks about and bring back proof. Track it in the area Bret names and take the shot cleanly.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found in shops, in the world and as activity rewards; a set is complete when every card in it is owned.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app at each new spot you visit and let it register the location.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the challenge list. Pick the short ones first and let the count build up across play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Lay low in alleys and off-road until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route past three shops and keep moving.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Drive anything new you see; each new model adds to the count.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger it in a busy fight and line up grouped enemies.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: get a plane off the ground without following the airport's scheduled flow. A small aircraft on a quiet runway is the easy way.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Face down the Rhinos: survive and beat back the tanks sent after you at high wanted levels. Heavy weapons and cover are essential.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, and leave before the alarm sounds.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway vehicle before you go in, and do not linger after the vault opens.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the cash and break line of sight before the police close in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel; visit every named district and back road.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang is enough, so work through the gang list.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Buy a drink at a beach bar and take in the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and onto the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Follow through on your throws and finish the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal: play through the story beat where your partnership goes public and the crowd reacts.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make story choices as you play; PSN tracks them up to 500. Keep choosing at every decision point and the trophy unlocks over time.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try: fail an attempt at something, then pull it off the very next time. It pops when the retry lands.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida. Keep an eye out in remote spots at odd hours for an event that does not fit.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: strike a pedestrian with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Feed bills through your laundering contacts until the total hits $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, food and cars all count toward the total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy each garage when it comes on the market.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the app and add each one.
